params.name: Chance
params.desc: The probability of extra drum hits being generated

params.name: Zoom
params.desc: Chooses which subdivision of the beat should be affected by the randomly generated extra hits

params.name: Range
params.desc: The range of velocities which will be assigned to the random hits

params.name: Midpoint
params.desc: The average velocity of the randomly generated hits

params.name: Pitch
params.desc: Alters the playback speed of the samples

params.name: Crop
params.desc: Crops the end of the samples, creating a staccato effect

params.name: Drop
params.desc: Mutes some or all of the drum channels

params.name: Drone
params.desc: Generates a drone which can be mixed with the drum sounds

params.name: Modulate
params.desc: The drone can be used to modulate the audio signal from the drums, creating a robotic effect

params.name: Tuning
params.desc: Controls the overall tuning of the drones

params.name: Note
params.desc: Alter the root note of the drones, in semitone steps over an octave range

params.name: Beat
params.desc: Chooses between a series of basic underlying drum patterns

params.name: Beats/Bar
params.desc: Alters the time signature of the beat

params.name: Swing
params.desc: Creates a swing feel to a beat by altering the timing of certain hits

params.name: Tempo
params.desc: Alters the tempo (BPM) of the beat
